messages:
Maya: quick thread — we need to pick the next 2 models for onboarding this quarter. customers (fintech + search vendor) pushing for lower latency + cheaper cost. want a short RICE-style pass and sequencing constraints. thoughts?
Sanjay: +1. can we treat Mistral-like vs Llama-like separately for infra impact?
Lina: yes — Mistral family gives better throughput on A100 for 8k seq, but kv/cache semantics differ. impact on runtime ~medium.
Ethan: customer ask: search vendor requires <=120ms tail gen for 512 tokens. they also need deterministic tokenization across hosts.
Maya: propose candidates: `mistral-1-8k-quant` and `llama2-13b-fp16`. quick RICE?
Lina: rough numbers: Reach=40k requests/mo for search, Impact=7 (per-customer retention), Confidence=0.6, Effort=4 (ops + quant tuning). RICE=(40*7*0.6)/4 ~ 168
Sanjay: for `llama2-13b-fp16`: Reach=25k, Impact=6, Confidence=0.8, Effort=2 -> (25*6*0.8)/2 = 60
Maya: that suggests Mistral quantized is higher score. but note engineering risk: prefix cache work and new kernel path.
Lina: Major tradeoff: quantized Mistral needs 4-bit kernels + QA on hallucination regressions. We need eval set runs (1000 prompts) and a quality gate: <2% regressions vs hosted baseline.
Ethan: also cost delta: predicted token cost per 1M tokens: Mistral-quant = $65, Llama-fp16 = $110. buyers care.
Sanjay: sequencing: if we onboard `mistral-quant` first, can we auto-fallback to `llama2-fp16` on degraded quality or capacity? yes if we wire routing policy. that helps reliability.
Maya: launch criteria proposal: 1) latency SLO: p95 <= 150ms for 512 tokens on dedicated pool; 2) quality gate: regression <2% on eval set; 3) canary traffic 10% for 48h w/ rollback hooks; 4) cost < $80 per 1M tokens. agree?
Lina: add: model card updated + quantization config checked in, plus per-route caching toggles.
Ethan: customer gating: for fintech, must support VPC private deployment and KMS integration. that affects effort -> revert RICE confidence down.
Sanjay: ops note: autoscaler needs a small change to weight quantized models differently (burst sizing). estimate 2 engineer-weeks. that bumps effort for Mistral to 6. recompute: (40*7*0.6)/6 ~ 112 -> still > llama but closer.
Maya: thanks — so action: Lina to run evals + make QA pass plan, Sanjay to scope autoscaler work and fallback wiring, Ethan to confirm fintech KMS checklist. we aim to finalize by EOD Fri.
Lina: started eval job `eval/mistral-quant/2026-03-19` — will post results here.
DeployBot: canary deploy scheduled: `mistral-quant-canary` -> queued, will not run until QA signoff.
Maya: perfect. if someone has a hard objection to ordering Mistral first, shout now, otherwise I’ll move it to the sprint board as top onboarding item.
